content: Temporal .NET: workflow code must be deterministic (no IO, no threading, no system clock, no external mutable state); use Workflow.* APIs; .editorconfig suppressions for *.workflow.cs (CA1024, CA1822, CA2007, CA2008, CA5394, CS1998, VSTHRD105); versioning via Workflow.Patched/DeprecatePatch or Worker Versioning; replay tests to verify. Source: docs.temporal.io/develop/dotnet/workflows/basics and /versioning.
